concepts.def: Tsarist troops fired on Father Gapon's petition march to Winter Palace; around 200 killed, sparked 1905 Revolution.
Lenin's programme on return from Switzerland: 'peace, land, bread' and 'all power to the Soviets'.
Naval base sailors' revolt against Bolshevik rule; brutally crushed by Trotsky, prompted NEP.
Stalin's forced merging of farms into kolkhozy; eliminated kulaks, caused 1932-33 Ukrainian famine (Holodomor) killing 5-7 million.
Stalin's purges: show trials of Bukharin, Zinoviev, Kamenev; 750,000 executions; gulag population reached 1.6 million.
Antisemitic conspiracy alleging Jewish doctors planned to murder Soviet leaders; ended by Stalin's death in March.
